Keep voice, karaoke, local BGM and channel outro. No generic spoken CTA. Visual direction: Use the photoreal live-action style in visualStyle, like varied Pexels-style footage. Generate a distinct Gemini still and Google Flow six-second clip per voiced scene; review action, 9:16 crop and continuity before binding local MP4s. Generated shots explain sourced facts and are not documentary proof. The title may tease the mechanism, but do not exaggerate risk, savings, universality or a company motive beyond the facts. The description should invite one topic-specific viewer response.
